{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_data = data[(data['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (data['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
conversion_rate = filtered_data['converted'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f"Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {len(filtered_data)}")
print(f"Number of converted orders among them: {filtered_data['converted'].sum()}")
print(f"Conversion rate (fraction): {conversion_rate}")"}
